asm::ineligible_carries_reason.detail: an ineligible survey must name WHY, with the identifiability reason (got 'independent_subject_anchor_not_observable')

asm::actor_object_path_can_be_eligible.detail: an actor_object_path survey with observed world, observed actor path and an executed run MUST be able to reach eligible — if this can never pass, the acceptance gate is unreachable and the invariant is a wall, not a rail (eligible=True, reason=None, failed=[])

asm::eligibility_collapses_on_unresolved.detail: an unresolved anchor actor must lose eligibility (got False)
